title: Copy for every reachable reason, then a test that keeps it complete
outcome: A user who is stopped reads a zh-TW sentence naming what actually happened, and a reason added later without copy fails a test instead of degrading silently.
acceptanceCriteria: The inventory is grouped by surface, not listed by reason. The three AlertDialog sites are all irreversible membership actions, where the user is stopped mid-action and a generic message costs the most; the toast sites include three read paths where it costs least.

The inventory records which reasons are unreachable and why, with UNHANDLED_ERROR as the worked example: it is always an UnexpectedError or TransientError and is absorbed by the server-error branch before any reason lookup.

Every reachable reason has a zh-TW title and description that name what went wrong in the user's terms. A reason whose best title beats the shared default gets one — that freedom is why the catalogue stores titles per entry.

The exhaustiveness test derives its reason set from the exports of src/entities/errors/index.ts. A hand-written list is what dropped ProfileReason from the original scoping, and it would drop the next enum too.

The exhaustiveness test lands after the copy, not before. Landing it first makes placeholder strings the cheapest way to green, and a green test over placeholder copy is worse than no test: it reports completeness that does not exist.
